operations.scientific_task: Compute depth-indexed normalized modal displacement shapes for layered Rayleigh/Love surface waves.

outputs_units.layer_interface_depth: km reconstructed from supplied cumulative thickness

constraints: Use the publicly exported actual swegn96 kernel; no local algorithm substitution.

numeric_oracle.derivation: Use the independent layered Love construction in GeoSurfaceWaveDispersion with c3km/s,T10s,Vs1=2,Vs2=4 and equal density. With u(0)=1, traction-free surface gives u(z)=cos(q1*z) in the top layer. At interface q1*h=atan(2sqrt(7/5)), u(h)=1/sqrt(6.6)=0.3892494721. Verify independently the exponentially decaying lower-halfspace form and zero surface traction.
